vibe_rationale: Long-running day-to-night outdoor club series from a trusted Sydney promoter with sharp curation, narrower than SURPLUS and promoter-run.
fit_notes: Adult summer day-party crowd outdoors in the heat, where hydration, sun care and recovery products fit naturally. Only three partners and a general info page are listed, and Astral People also co-runs Hazard Festival, so one relationship could open more than one event.
